Sets the topic to query and subscribe to. The topic specified can be the
literal topic name, or a regular expression that matches multiple topics.

Specifies how to order the results within the paginated result set. If the
OrderBy is not provided, the results are ordered by the SowKey for the
messages.

A comma-separated list of options for the command. Set the number of
results returned with top_n, and the starting point within the result set
with skip_n. For example, to display records 31-50 of the result set, you
could provide the following option:
top_n=20,skip_n=30,oof
This tells AMPS to skip the first 30 records of the result set, and then
provide the top 20 records from the remaining results. Out of focus
notifications will be provided.
